name: video-studio
description: Provider-neutral knowledge-to-video compiler: turns text, URLs, documents and repos into reproducible videos with captions, thumbnails and provenance.

runway_key.title: Runway API key
runway_key.description: Optional. Runway API secret for generative video (exposed to the engine as RUNWAYML_API_SECRET).

elevenlabs_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_key.description: Optional. ElevenLabs key for voiceover and word timings (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY).

heygen_key.title: HeyGen API key
heygen_key.description: Optional. HeyGen v3 key for presenter videos (HEYGEN_API_KEY).

fal_key.title: fal.ai API key
fal_key.description: Optional. fal.ai key for Kling, Veo and Hailuo models (FAL_KEY).
